name: elysiajs
headline: React Stack Patterns: Choose the Right Stack
short_description: This skill provides guidance for mid-to-senior developers on choosing the right React stack, covering build tools, frameworks, and routing solutions. It's aimed at developers starting new React projects who need to navigate the complex ecosystem.
author: patternsdev

sections.overview:
React Stack Patterns provides structured guidance for selecting build tools, frameworks, and routing solutions when starting new React projects. It addresses the complexity of the modern React ecosystem by helping mid-to-senior developers make informed decisions about their technical stack. The skill covers architectural choices and best practices for organizing React applications. It's designed for teams evaluating multiple options and needing a clear framework for stack selection. This guidance simplifies decision-making across tools like build systems, state management, and routing libraries.
Choosing a framework for new React projects
Evaluating modern ecosystem options
Selecting build tools for a specific project
Understanding routing options for React applications
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/patternsdev/skills --skill react-2026`
`git clone https://github.com/patternsdev/skills`
sections.usage:
```
I'm starting a new React project in [COMPANY] within the [INDUSTRY] sector. My team needs to choose a stack that balances performance, scalability, and developer experience. What are the recommended React stack patterns for [DATA] (e.g., a data-heavy dashboard, a real-time collaboration tool, or a static marketing site)? Include build tools, state management, and routing solutions tailored to [COMPANY]'s needs.
```
Copy

```
# React Stack Recommendations for Acme Corp's Data Dashboard
```
